recommendation: Full is justified for artifact_snapshots under unchanged workflow-families-v1

baseline.rule: All material responsibilities need verified shared Go support, declarative inputs and preserved guards; usable entry points alone earn no Full credit.
baseline.original_contract: Create/index/hash immutable snapshots and restore or inventory explicit versions.
baseline.conditional_count_effect: If the owner adopts this recommendation, current4/14 becomes5/14 (35.71%); this report changes no ledger.

requirements.duty: Create immutable versions from explicit artifacts
requirements.reason: snapshotArtifacts copies a regular source into an exclusively reserved tag/artifact.bin, verifies bytes, publishes receipt last and syncs directories. It never reuses a tag or shares the source inode. Immutable means immutable through this tool, matching the copy-based original duty, not OS write protection.

requirements.duty: Index recorded versions and retain identity when payload is missing
requirements.reason: Each tag has a separately persisted receipt; directory enumeration supplies the index. A retained receipt still exposes metadata and payload-missing status after artifact.bin disappears. The tool deletes neither receipts nor tag directories. A separate aggregate git-tracked ledger is a storage/backup format choice, not a missing index operation.

requirements.duty: Hash artifact bytes and bind size
requirements.reason: Source prehash and identity/size/mtime checks bind the receipt; streamed publication verifies expected size/digest and hashes destination readback. Both create and restore use these shared paths.

requirements.duty: Restore explicit versions with digest checks before and after copying
requirements.reason: Explicit tag resolves only fixed payload/receipt names. Receipt and payload are validated, full stored digest is checked before output creation, and the same descriptor is rewound for verified publication/readback. Restoration to a new explicit file preserves the version's bytes while enforcing the recommendation's stronger exclusive-output guard.

List reports receipts plus missing, incomplete, unsafe and size-mismatched states. Present payloads are explicitly unverified; no historical hash is misrepresented as freshly measured. Legacy cmd_list also reports recorded versions and missing files without rehashing.

requirements.duty: Carry paths, tags, revision, digest, size and provenance
requirements.reason: SnapshotOptions supplies explicit source/output/store/tag/revision/note. SnapshotReceipt records absolute source, tag, UTC date, full revision, note, size and SHA256. Caller-supplied revision authority is disclosed; automatic git-HEAD discovery and checkout warnings are incidental acquisition/UI choices, not stronger attestation in the original script, whose git lookup could return None.

requirements.duty: Preserve originals, avoid overwrite/ambiguous tags and mutable sharing
requirements.reason: Read-only source handles plus new-inode copies preserve sources. All outputs use O_EXCL, protecting existing original/source/other files and aliases; no in-place restore exists. Duplicate tags refuse rather than selecting an ambiguous latest match. Static final symlink paths refuse. No deletion/retention action is inferred from inventory.

historical_differences.legacy_ledger_import: Not a missing material duty. backup_iso load_manifest/cmd_list are the old index implementation; Go has an equivalent receipt index, including missing-payload metadata. Automatic ingestion of that legacy JSON is compatibility/migration work. Existing historical records are not thereby claimed migrated or retired.
historical_differences.workspace_auditing: The second source row has both artifact_snapshot and evidence_report capabilities. Its snapshot portion inventories known versions/provenance. verify.workspace_isos additionally crawls all workspace ISOs, searches references, assigns project roles, reports inode/link/allocation metadata and groups recorded equal hashes. Those are broader workspace/evidence-report duties, not absent operations on explicit snapshot versions. They remain unimplemented Go reporting breadth and are not counted complete here.
historical_differences.overwrite_restore_and_duplicate_override: Historical copy2 may overwrite a chosen working destination and allow duplicate labels. The frozen recommendation explicitly requires exclusive output and resolving duplicate ambiguity. The safer new-output/unique-tag contract fulfills those guards without reproducing unsafe historical permissions.

verification_basis.positive_workflow_evidence: Existing snapshot proof and ordinary review cover independent31-byte/2MiB create-preview/create/list/restore-preview/restore, exact byte/hash readback, source preservation, duplicate/overwrite/corruption/missing/unsafe receipt and payload refusals, and invalid stream cleanup.
verification_basis.integrated_checkpoint: registry-owner-proof records uncached full package race145.271s plus vet/build/format/scans, with current snapshot/writer/input production pins. Current patch_test.go differs afterward only by the reviewed authoring-flow addition; its snapshot test block is byte-identical to that integrated baseline (static cmp).
verification_basis.Serena: snapshotArtifacts has one production caller in run; existing shared publisher/input owner references were reviewed. This is a manager with declarative inputs, not merely a copy/hash primitive.
verification_basis.fresh_execution: None: static source/JSON/hash/comparison inspection only; no test, Go/Python tool, ISO, registry, emulator or process access.

smallest_required_enhancement: None identified for this frozen family contract. Do not add ledger-import/workspace-audit machinery merely to earn snapshot credit.
limits: No hostile same-user namespace mutation or atomic live-filesystem snapshot guarantee; legacy copy-based workflow supplied neither.
No implicit checkout, historical ledger migration, in-place working-file replacement, workspace audit completion, retention/deletion or retirement approval.
Recommendation rests on requirement crosswalk plus verified end-to-end evidence, not on absence of a bug or a new test run.
